feed.title: NPR Topics: Home Page Top Stories
feed.subtitle: Top stories in the U.S. and world news, politics, health, science, business, music, arts and culture. Nonprofit journalism with a mission. This is NPR.

entry.title: Sally Rooney's books will no longer be sold in U.K. after Palestinian Action support
entry.summary: The Irish author said her books can no longer be sold in the UK after she pledged the royalties to a banned pro-Palestinian group.

entry.title: 'Everything got worse': Gen Z express frustration, regret after Trump vote
entry.summary: A focus group of eight Gen Z Trump voters reported feeling unhappy or disappointed with the state of politics, with some going as far as to say they regret supporting him in 2024.

entry.title: How much money has Musk given to Republican groups since July? The quiz knows
entry.summary: Plus, this week saw comings and goings at the White House, the revenge of a child (reality) star, and Elon Musk doing Elon Musk things.

entry.title: Do Americans own the president's papers? Appeals court to weigh in
entry.summary: The administration says papers created in the White House belong to Donald Trump, not to the American people. The case could ultimately end up at the conservative-leaning Supreme Court.

entry.title: A rare family of barn owls moved into Manhattan's Upper West Side. New Yorkers are captivated
entry.summary: Manhattan's Upper West Side has been reveling in the company of its latest celebrities: A family of barn owls nested in a water tower atop a building near Central Park.

entry.title: Brewers sweep the Dodgers to reach the World Series for the first time since 1982
entry.summary: Propelled by a lockdown bullpen and repeated comebacks, the Brewers swept the two-time defending champion LA Dodgers out of the playoffs Thursday in Game 4 of the National League Championship Series.

entry.title: Hit a midlife wall? Here's how to rediscover your strengths
entry.summary: As part of her new podcast and newsletter Your Turn with Allison Aubrey, NPR's Allison Aubrey went in search of tools to help navigate midlife — starting with this survey to rank one's character strengths.

entry.title: Suspicious mailings to election officials, congressional offices under investigation
entry.summary: The FBI and U.S. Postal Inspection Service are looking into the mailings, some of which included an unidentified powdery white substance.

entry.title: U.S. historic preservation law faces the most serious threat in its 60-year history
entry.summary: Congress and a federal agency are threatening to weaken the country's historic preservation law, fueling a backlash that critics say is as fiery as the one that led to the law's creation 60 years ago.

entry.title: Inside a Chicago home, a photographer documents the life her family built
entry.summary: For eight years, photographer Jennifer Teresa Villanueva has documented her Mexican American family's everyday life in Chicago, capturing intimate moments of love, labor and sacrifice.
